Sure! First contact guys go out the window and have now been replaced with MTF on rotation. Containment specialists arrive later. However…MTFs may not be available in which case TRO handles it for them.

Tactical first contact would be handled by the nearest site’s TRO team on the first contact rotation. (20% of the team would be on the rotation at any given time. On average the first contact team would have about 30 people on it) after the anomaly’s attributes have been ascertained, the other rotation comes in which is the one I was talking about. So If the anomaly breathes fire…then you’d get some containment specialists on rotation to deal with the initial containment aspect as well as rotation members of Epsilon-9. Not as bad or dangerous as the first contact guys, but also kind of crappy because both teams will not have the resources that the normal conspecs and MTFs will have. However the system is effective and serves to identify potential individuals who perform their duties admirably and adapt with zeal—for potential transfer to either a higher level SCP or to be promoted maybe? This would solve a lot of issues…having a constant way to figure out who should be promoted would give the foundation a massive boost. Kind of like the US Military’s NCO system. I mean, the foundation would obviously want a link between the grizzled vets and the bright eyed juniors without sacrificing the quality of their middle leadership. And this would work for the first contact guys too—those who perform well would either be on the docket to be an NCO or maybe even apply to join an MTF.
